Thanks Vanessa — I reviewed the redaction draft and the coverage notes. A few specifics for procurement:
- Scope confirmation: The test included external APIs, customer-facing inference endpoints, and the management plane for dedicated/private offerings. The following were explicitly out of scope: on-prem installer artifacts and air-gapped ops.
- The medium finding Vanessa referenced (libx) has a vendor CVE we tracked as CVE-2026-4457; vendor patch ETA 2026-12-28. Compensating control: temporary WAF rule and heightened monitoring which we will maintain until vendor patch.
- Risk acceptance: Security can provide a short acceptance note for Pilot Products that documents the compensating control and the remediation ETA.

I’ll attach the remediation tracker and the acceptance paragraph to Vanessa’s outgoing package.
